criteria.name: Contribution points:
content: Failing to contribute to the team = give them only 50% of the points they would have received
Disruptive behaviour/got a strike during event = give them only 25% of the points they would have received

criteria.name: Mission points:
content: Every server-wide event in Zombies completed successfully= +2pts

criteria.name: Achievement points:
content: UNIT Personnel rescued (they must start as a survivor) = +1pt
Survival point (did 3 medium+ missions consecutively) = +2 pt (does not stack)
Notable action (host discretion) (must be elaborated on in the event log) = +1pt (does not stack)
